parameters.name: InterfaceType
parameters.description: The port's interface type, or 0 if no interface type has been received. Note: It is assumed that it might be used for HTIP (Home-network Topology Identifying Protocol) {{bibref|JJ-300.00}} and {{bibref|G.9973}}. In this case, it's an IANA interface type {{bibref|IANAifType}}. For example, IANAifType defines the following interface types for wired line (UTP cable), wireless line, power line, and coaxial cable: * ''6'' (Wired line) * ''71'' (Wireless) * ''174'' (PLC) * ''236'' (Coaxial cable)

parameters.name: MACForwardingTable
parameters.description: The port's MAC forwarding table, or the value is {{empty}} if no forwarding table was supplied.

object.description: The port's link information, which is included in the value of the ''LLDPDU's'' Organizationally Specific TLV (TLV Type = 127). Note: It is assumed that this object might be used for HTIP (Home-network Topology Identifying Protocol) {{bibref|JJ-300.00}} and {{bibref|G.9973}}. In this case, the {{bibref|OUI}} in the third octet is E0271A (''TTC-OUI'') and the organizationally defined subtype in the sixth octet is 2 (''Link Information'').
